name: M5.Character.character_add
statement: ∀ (D : ℕ) (λ z u : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), M5.Character.value λ (z + u) = M5.Character.value λ z * M5.Character.value λ u
context:
theorem M5.Character.bit_add : ∀ a b c : ZMod 2, M5.Character.bitSign a (b + c) = M5.Character.bitSign a b * M5.Character.bitSign a c := by
  change ∀ a b c : ZMod 2, M5.Character.bitSign a (b + c) = M5.Character.bitSign a b * M5.Character.bitSign a c
  intro a b c
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> fin_cases c
  all_goals
    unfold M5.Character.bitSign
    first
    | change (-1 : _) ^ (0 : ℕ) = (-1) ^ (0 : ℕ) * (-1) ^ (0 : ℕ)
    | change (-1 : _) ^ (1 : ℕ) = (-1) ^ (0 : ℕ) * (-1) ^ (1 : ℕ)
    | change (-1 : _) ^ (1 : ℕ) = (-1) ^ (1 : ℕ) * (-1) ^ (0 : ℕ)
    | change (-1 : _) ^ (0 : ℕ) = (-1) ^ (1 : ℕ) * (-1) ^ (1 : ℕ)
  all_goals norm_num
guidance: Unfold value, Pi addition; use accepted bit_add pointwise and Finset.prod_mul_distrib. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.
